headline: China calls for AI cooperation with the US ahead of APEC
body: A quiet Sunday. China called for AI cooperation with the US ahead of the APEC summit in Shenzhen, lifting Global Coordination by 0.22. The US disrupted North Korea's 'FaceStealer' deepfake-call scheme, tied to more than $400 million in crypto theft, nudging Catastrophic Risk up. OpenAI credited GPT-6 Astra with a proof step toward a lattice definition of the Standard Model. Gatekeeper and 1984 rose slightly. Horizon Balance slipped to -20.15 from -20.04.
movers_note: Gatekeeper +0.13, from China's cooperation call (+0.17). 1984 +0.09, from the cooperation call (+0.10). Libertarian Utopia -0.08, from the FaceStealer scheme (-0.07).
